newsitem.title: MOROCCO: World Bank to hold forum on Mediterranean training.
newsitem.headline: World Bank to hold forum on Mediterranean training.

text.p: The World Bank's Economic Development Institute agency will hold a five-day forum in Morocco in May to spread technological knowledge and help training in developing countries in the Mediterranean.

In a statement received on Wednesday, the agency said the event would launch the Mediterranean Development Forum, "a broad partnership initiative devoted to disseminating knowledge and encouraging the formation of skills among the development community in the region."
About 400 private sector representatives, government officials and development experts are expected to attend the forum in the Moroccan city of Marrakesh from May 12 to 17, the agency said.
The forum will include workshops, panels, demonstrations of technology and educational activities.
